# CodingEasyPeasy

> > Programming tutorials and guides covering Python, Node.js, TypeScript, web development, database management, and security best practices.

CodingEasyPeasy provides comprehensive tutorials for modern web development, focusing on full-stack technologies including Python frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy), JavaScript ecosystems (Node.js, React, Vue.js, Next.js), database management, security implementations, and DevOps practices. The site emphasizes practical, example-driven learning for developers at various skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Node.js
- TypeScript
- JavaScript
- HTML/CSS
- Flask
- FastAPI
- React Router
- Vue Router
- Next.js
- SQLAlchemy
- Git & SSH Authentication
- Web Scraping
- Microservices Security
- Database Connection Pooling

## Core Pages

- [CodingEasyPeasy](https://codingeasypeasy.com): Homepage featuring HTML/CSS tutorials and interactive web development projects
- [About](https://codingeasypeasy.com/about): CodingEasyPeasy platform overview: programming tutorials and math resources

## JavaScript & Frontend Frameworks

- [Next.js Route Handlers: A Comprehensive Guide With Examples (API Routes Replacement)](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/nextjs-route-handlers-a-comprehensive-guide-with-examples-api-routes-replacement): Complete guide to Next.js Route Handlers replacing API Routes in app directory
- [React Router V6 Tutorial: A Complete Guide To Navigation In React Apps](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/react-router-v6-tutorial-a-complete-guide-to-navigation-in-react-apps): Complete React Router v6 tutorial for SPA navigation and client-side routing
- [Vue Router Tutorial: A Complete Guide To Setting Up Navigation In Vue.js](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/vue-router-tutorial-a-complete-guide-to-setting-up-navigation-in-vuejs): Set up Vue Router for Vue.js SPAs with comprehensive installation guide
- [Vue.js With TypeScript: A Comprehensive Guide To Building Robust Applications](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/vuejs-with-typescript-a-comprehensive-guide-to-building-robust-applications): Build robust Vue.js apps with TypeScript using Vue CLI and Vite setup

## Python & Backend Development

- [Secure Service-to-Service Communication: Implementing MTLS With FastAPI](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/secure-service-to-service-communication-implementing-mtls-with-fastapi): Implement mTLS for secure microservices with FastAPI, OpenSSL, and Uvicorn
- [Web Scraping With Flask: A Comprehensive Guide With Python](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/web-scraping-with-flask-a-comprehensive-guide-with-python): Build web scraping apps with Flask, Beautiful Soup, and Python Requests
- [Visualize Complex Functions With Python: A Comprehensive Guide To 3D Plotting And More](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/visualize-complex-functions-with-python-a-comprehensive-guide-to-3d-plotting-and-more): Create 3D plots and visualizations with Python matplotlib and numpy
- [Optimize Flask SQLAlchemy Engine Configuration: A Comprehensive Guide](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/optimize-flask-sqlalchemy-engine-configuration-a-comprehensive-guide): Optimize Flask-SQLAlchemy engine with connection pooling and performance tuning
- [SQLAlchemy And Asyncpg Connection Pooling: Best Practices For Performance And Reliability](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/sqlalchemy-and-asyncpg-connection-pooling-best-practices-for-performance-and-reliability): Optimize SQLAlchemy and asyncpg connection pooling for Python performance

Credential Helpers - A Comprehensive Guide](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/git-authentication-ssh-keys-vs-https-with-credentials-vs-credential-helpers-a-comprehensive-guide): Compare Git authentication methods: SSH keys, HTTPS, and credential helpers
